title: The Anatomy of a Short Squeeze
summary: A 96-second animated cut follows a short seller from a share loan to the margin call and buyback that close his trade.

scenes.label: The call
scenes.headline: At midnight, the phone lights up
scenes.narration: At midnight, his broker calls. A trade meant to make money is eating through his cash.

scenes.label: The loan
scenes.headline: Borrow one share
scenes.narration: Earlier that day, he borrowed one share. He can sell it right away. But he still owes the lender a share.

scenes.label: The sale
scenes.headline: Sell it for $20
scenes.narration: He sells it for twenty dollars. If the stock falls, he can buy it back for less and keep the difference.

scenes.label: The price rises
scenes.headline: Buyers bid it up to $50
scenes.narration: Instead, buyers pile in. The stock was twenty dollars. Now someone is willing to pay fifty.

scenes.label: The loss
scenes.headline: Selling at $20 and buying at $50
scenes.narration: He sold for twenty. Buying back one share now costs fifty. That's a thirty-dollar loss if he closes here, before fees.

scenes.label: The cash cushion
scenes.headline: The buyback would use all $50
scenes.narration: The broker holds his twenty-dollar sale, plus thirty of his own cash. That's fifty dollars in the account. Buying back the share would use all fifty. His cushion is gone.

scenes.label: The margin call
scenes.headline: Add $15 or close the trade
scenes.narration: Here, the broker wants a cushion of thirty percent. At fifty dollars a share, that's fifteen dollars. To stay short, he has to add fifteen. Or he can close the trade.

scenes.label: Back to the exchange
scenes.headline: He heads back to buy a share
scenes.narration: He can't add the cash. So he heads back to the exchange.

scenes.label: The buyback
scenes.headline: His $50 order is filled
scenes.narration: He buys one share for fifty. Across the room, other short sellers start buying too.

scenes.label: The feedback loop
scenes.headline: More buying pushes up the price
scenes.narration: Their orders can push the price up again. That puts more shorts under pressure to buy. That's the short squeeze.

scenes.label: GameStop
scenes.headline: GameStop's short interest in 2021
scenes.narration: GameStop's short interest topped its public float in twenty twenty-one. The report found that broader buying sustained the rally.

scenes.label: The return
scenes.headline: The trader returns the share
scenes.narration: He returns the share. His short is closed, and the loss is real.
